known.name: Dynamic wallpaper
known.description: Replace the device wallpaper with a theme-supplied image (Android) or installable live photo / wallpaper asset (iOS).

known.name: Custom icons
known.description: Provide an icon set for the user's launcher (Android) or custom-icon mechanism (iOS).

known.name: Widgets
known.description: Installable home/lock-screen widget packs rendered by the platform's widget framework.

known.name: Lock screen
known.description: Theming of the lock screen (widgets, clock face, palette).

known.name: StandBy
known.description: Theming of the idle/StandBy screen shown when the device is charging and unlocked.

known.name: Focus
known.description: Theming driven by the platform Focus mode (notifications, sound, appearance).

unknown.name: App Store custom app icons
unknown.source: iOS platform constraint: no public API to change app icons; requires App Store distribution and review.

unknown.name: Android system lock-screen wallpaper
unknown.source: Android lock screen is a launcher/OS surface without a public wallpaper API; theming depends on the launcher.
